## Measurements and reference values

- [statement] Quantizing KV cache tensors to 4-bit or 8-bit in MLX reduces context memory growth from ~9.0 GB to ~2.5 GB at 64k tokens on 35B parameter models with negligible loss in retrieval recall. (high confidence) — https://github.com/ml-explore/mlx · keywords: MLX KV Cache Quantization and Zero-Copy Pointer Passing · also: https://github.com/ml-explore/mlx-examples/tree/main/llms

## Facts and statements

- [statement] MLX allocates tensor buffers directly into unified memory pages mapped with shared CPU-GPU storage modes, eliminating DMA transfers and serialization overhead. (high confidence) — https://github.com/ml-explore/mlx · keywords: MLX KV Cache Quantization and Zero-Copy Pointer Passing · also: https://github.com/ml-explore/mlx-examples/tree/main/llms
